nodes.speaker: Artist
nodes.text: Welcome to the studio! This is where design comes to life.

nodes.speaker: Artist
text: Desaogo is a design tool. It helps you create and iterate on visual work with a clean, focused interface.
Think of it as a creative workspace — stripped down to what matters. No clutter, just creation.

nodes.speaker: Artist
nodes.text: The portal to Desaogo is on the right side. Open to everyone — go create something!

nodes.speaker: Artist
nodes.text: Check out the artwork on the walls. Each piece was made using the tool. The portal is on the right whenever inspiration strikes.

nodes.speaker: Artist
nodes.text: Press ESC to head back outside. Stay creative!
